[[Andorra]], represented by the [[Andorran Olympic Committee]], sent a team of five athletes to compete at the [[2008 Summer Olympics]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]].

==Athletics==
{{main|Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

Two Andorran athletes participated in the athletics events – [[Antoni Bernadó]] in the [[Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's marathon|men's marathon]]<ref name="marathon"/> and [[Montserrat Pujol (sprinter)|Montserrat Pujol]] in the [[Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's 100 metres|women's 100 m]].<ref name="100m"/>

The heats for the women's 100 m took place on 16 August 2008. Pujol contested heat six which took place at 11:25{{nbsp}}am. She finished seventh of nine starts in a time of 12.73 seconds and failed to advance to the semi-finals.<ref name="100m">{{cite web |title=Olympic Games, Beijing (National Stadium) 2008, 100 metres women |url=https://worldathletics.org/competitions/olympic-games/the-xxix-olympic-games-6977748/results/women/100-metres/heats/result |publisher=World Athletics |access-date=1 April 2025}}</ref>

The men's marathon took place eight days later on 24 August 2008 at 7:30{{nbsp}}am. Bernadó completed the race in a time of 2 hours, 26 minutes and 29 seconds to finish 58th overall.<ref name="marathon">{{cite web |title=Olympic Games, Beijing (National Stadium) 2008, Marathon men |url=https://worldathletics.org/competitions/olympic-games/the-xxix-olympic-games-6977748/results/men/marathon/final/result |publisher=World Athletics |access-date=1 April 2025}}</ref>

==Canoeing==
{{main|Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

One Andorran athlete participated in the canoeing events – [[Montserrat García Riberaygua]] in the [[Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's slalom K-1|women's slalom K-1]].<ref name="canoe">{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics – Canoe Slalom – Kayak Singles, Slalom, Women |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/258863 |website=[[Olympedia]] |access-date=1 April 2025}}</ref>

The preliminary round for the women's slalom K-1 was held on 13 August 2008. Over two runs, García Riberaygua's total time was 268.93 seconds as she placed 20th of the 21 competitors and was eliminated from the competition.<ref name="canoe"/>

==Judo==
{{main|Judo at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

One Andorran athlete participated in the judo events – [[Daniel García González|Daniel García]] in the [[Judo at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's 66 kg|men's −66 kg]].<ref name="judo">{{cite web |title=Judo Men -66kg Contest List |url=http://results.beijing2008.cn:80/WRM/ENG/INF/JU/C75/JUM066000.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080811172040/http://results.beijing2008.cn:80/WRM/ENG/INF/JU/C75/JUM066000.shtml |publisher=Beijing 2008 |access-date=1 April 2025 |archive-date=11 August 2008}}</ref>

The men's −66 kg event took place on 10 August 2008. García received a bye in the preliminary round but lost by [[ippon]] to [[Yordanis Arencibia]] of Cuba in the round of 32. In the repechage contest, García lost by ippon to [[Amin El Hady]] of Egypt.<ref name="judo"/>

==Swimming==
{{main|Swimming at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

One Andorran athlete participated in the swimming events – [[Hocine Haciane]] in the [[Swimming at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's 400 metre individual medley|men's 400 m individual medley]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Competition Results, Olympic Games Beijing 2008 |url=https://www.worldaquatics.com/competitions/657/olympic-games-beijing-2008/results?disciplines= |publisher=World Aquatics |access-date=1 April 2025}}</ref>

The heats for the men's 400 m individual medley took place on 9 August 2008 at 11:33{{nbsp}}am. Haciane contested heat five and started in lane five. He finished first in his heat in a time of 4 minutes and 32 seconds which was ultimately not fast enough to qualify for the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=Competition Results, Olympic Games Beijing 2008 |url=https://www.worldaquatics.com/competitions/657/olympic-games-beijing-2008/results?disciplines=&event=15261555-7416-4d8c-8597-1274c066a39c&unit=heat-5 |publisher=World Aquatics |access-date=1 April 2025}}</ref>
